rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML systems, real-time inference, and LLM tooling complements Sharon's work building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai. Both operate in the llm-tooling domain and are focused on shipping robust, deployable AI systems—Artem from the ML engineering and research side, Sharon from the infrastructure and vertical-AI angle. This is a natural fit for exploring how cutting-edge ML can power real-world agent deployments.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Sharon — you're both building in the production AI infrastructure space and should compare notes on llm-tooling approaches and deployment challenges.
